description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the recent sequence ratio (expressed as a percentage on the x-axis, ranging from 0 to 100) and two metrics: perplexity (plotted on the left y-axis, with values from 4.2 to 4.7) and GPU memory ratio (plotted on the right y-axis, with values from 40 to 100%). The plot includes three distinct lines: a dashed red line labeled "Perplexity," which remains relatively stable around a value of 4.35 across the entire range of the x-axis; a solid blue line labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio," which shows a steady increase from approximately 42% to 95% as the recent sequence ratio increases; and a dotted blue line labeled "Full Cache GPU Mem.," which remains constant at 100% across the entire range of the x-axis. The "Perplexity" line exhibits a sharp decline from about 4.6 to 4.35 between 0% and 20% on the x-axis, followed by a fluctuating pattern that stays near 4.35. The "GPU Mem. Ratio" line shows a gradual increase until around 80%, where it sharply rises to 95%.
